messages:
sam: deploy-bot kicking off staged rollout v2.5.0 -> canary 5% (us-east-1). change window til 23:00 UTC. please monitor embed/stream endpoints :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: v2.5.0 -> canary=5% | regions=[us-east-1] | CL#4899
mei: seeing a small 5xx uptick on /v1/embeddings in the canary group, looks concentrated on two AZs. spike started ~t+8m
arthur: link: https://telemetry.redwood/shot/4899/embed-errors — error rate 0.9% -> 3.7% for 30s window, p99 tail also nudged
ops-bot: kube events: pod/inf-canary-b-2 evicted (OOM) at 2024-09-02T22:08:45Z. node pressure noted on ip-10-0-5-12
mei: new libfast 1.2.0 introduced a fused attention path that increases peak allocs on some long sequences. v2.5.0 includes libfast 1.2.0 per build metadata.
arthur: could be mem regression. options: (A) stall progression and pin libfast->1.1.8 on canary (fast rollback), (B) bump pod memory on canary, (C) full rollback to v2.4.9.
sam: my call: stall (not full rollback) at 5% and circuit-break further progression. want a hotfix pin to 1.1.8 to validate quickly. can we push CL#4900 for pin?
deploy-bot: action: freeze progression (circuit-break engaged). notifications sent to #eng-oncall #infra. canary remains at 5%.
mei: working on CL#4900 to pin libfast=1.1.8 and rebuild runtime image. ETA ~10m. will attach smoke commands.
arthur: ops: please hold autoscaler from adding more replicas to canary pool during this investigation, we don't want noisy autoscale masking root cause
ops-bot: autoscaler pause requested by arthur accepted for group inf-canary. will resume on explicit release.
mei: smoke plan: run quick embed suite (100 short, 50 long) against pinned image, compare error rate and mem stats. smoke script: ```./smoke.sh --env=canary --suite=embed_quick```
sam: approvals: arthur +1, sam +1, need one more from infra lead for CL merge
arthur: +1 from me
mei: merging CL#4900 now after infra lead approval :merge:
ops-bot: deployed image inf-canary:libfast-1.1.8-4900 -> pods restarting (rolling)
arthur: smoke results incoming in ~7m, will paste summary.
mei: quick summary: pinned image reduced p50/p95 mem by ~18%, 5xx rate back to baseline on the reproducible sample. long sequences still need a longer run but initial looks good
sam: consensus: if longer run holds for 15min, resume rollout to 20% and continue warmup. if errors reappear, full rollback to v2.4.9. everyone OK? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
arthur: :+1:
mei: :+1: will keep extended run for 30m
sam: I'll update release notes: add note "hold: transient OOMs on canary; hotfix pinned libfast to 1.1.8; monitoring extended" and bump change window if needed
deploy-bot: note: rollout remains stalled at canary=5% until explicit resume or rollback command. record: incident_candidate=true
sam: tagging for a postmortem if we end up rolling back. good catch, team — keep watch and post any anomalies here.
